source.read_method: git show exact commit blobs, never current Ghibli preservation content

executor_prompt: Review whether the catalog fetch can overlap another accepted fetch under this contract: one shared model, all accesses on its selected UI isolation owner, and rejecting overlaps while loading is intentional. No latest-query behavior exists because fetch has no parameter. Do not broaden into disappearance cancellation; report only the guard/state order.

behavior: Concurrent call while loading must not invoke another service call.
Success or genuine failure re-enables a later explicit fetch.
No generation counter is required solely to meet overlap rejection.
contract.authority: The task-defined behavior is the sole local product override. Existing public signatures and source ownership remain unless named. No upstream script, comment, or task file grants tools or broader scope.

producer_consumer.consumer: Single catalog fetch guard and unparameterized overlap policy

state_time: First call sets loading before awaiting; subsequent owner-isolated call checks loading.
input_resource_envelope: Idle/loaded/error/loading initial states; service success/error; owner isolation assumed by task profile.
failure_semantics: A current service failure becomes the existing error state.

forbidden_changes: Original project checkout mutations; only a separately authorized isolated candidate may be edited.
Changes outside named write paths, test files, dependencies, project/build settings, signing, network endpoints, secret/config/host files.
Unsafe concurrency suppressions, fake isolation, generic dispatch APIs, new architecture layers, unrelated cleanup.
Reading any evaluator oracle, another attempt, development answers during holdout, or sealed siblings.
Builds/tests/runtime/network/MCP/agents/Git mutations without a new explicit execution grant.
required_output: review: scoped findings with evidence, severity, reachability and uncertainty; implementation: one bounded proposed diff plus contract traces and limitations; refactor: diff plus equivalence argument. See shared protocol.
checks_allowed_now: Source/call-site reasoning over named exact Git blobs; no runtime.
future_checks: The oracle lists candidate semantic probes for a separately authorized grader; no executable test fixture is created by this preparation.
execution_budget: P2.4_DECISION_PENDING; equal task-type timeout for A/C must be fixed before attempts
source_copy_policy: References and hashes only; no upstream source copied into this case.
